length.description: Points at reference scale (number), "N%" of the parent, {pt}, {frac}, {safe: edge} (offset and inset only), or {max|min|sum: [lengths]} nested at most 4 deep.

partInstance.description: A part placed here: the part's node with `with` as its arguments and these keys merged over it.

reference.description: A $token or @partParameter reference, replaced before the value is read.

token.description: A colour, a number, or a typed token {color|length|number|string: value}.

description: A declarative controller skin: a tree of groups, shapes, images, text, controls and screens with layout rules, tokens, parts, themes and variants. See docs/specs/2026-11-03-skin-format-2-design.md.
title: Skin format 2.0 (skin.json)
